style: Asset-free pachinko LCD motion with a near-black mechanical depth field, beveled cyan-to-red-to-gold energy rails, and a controlled rainbow jackpot release. It must read as light moving behind the physical board rather than graphics covering it.
shot_brief: The LCD wakes as restrained cyan energy in four nested perimeter rails, heats through red while leaving the reel area untouched, briefly slams a deep-extruded 「激熱」 into the upper safe band, then pulls the same rails into a gold frame and holds its breath at the host pause point. On a winning resume, the rails reverse outward and release a saturated rainbow surge. The single dominant motion idea is energy traveling along and through the same perimeter rails; no characters, logos, imported imagery, simulated PUSH button, or center-covering effects appear.

motif.description: Four nested beveled rectangular rails stay anchored to the outer 14% of the frame. Their travel speed, color, glow, and direction carry every phase; they never cross the central reel-safe zone.
motif.pattern_interrupt: At frame 140, reverse only the travel direction of the established rails from inward convergence to outward release; keep their geometry and camera fixed.

avoid: all typography, particles, bloom cores, and rail crossings inside center_safe_zone_px
a drawn PUSH button or cursor because the physical foreground supplies that UI

type_treatment.position: centered in text_zone_px, never in the reel-safe center
type_treatment.extrusion: 12 deterministic offset depth layers down-right, near-black #100207 at the outer depth and #3A0710 near the face
type_treatment.shine: one narrow white gradient-text sweep from upper-left to lower-right between frames 72 and 80
type_treatment.exit: scale_out and fade_out before the gold hold

animation_rules.use: Drive the single 「激熱」 entrance on frame 63 with a short scale-slam and one restrained landing shake.
Build the requested dark, high-dimensional outer extrusion while keeping the bright face crisp.
Move a finite white shine across the held face without moving the glyphs.
Supply bounded cyan, red, gold, and rainbow rail glow; keep bloom away from the safe center and below full-white exposure.

playback_gate.pre_resume_state: stable gold convergence with a subtle hold_breath pulse
playback_gate.non_winning_path: the host must not advance into rainbow-release
playback_gate.integration_note: Frame 139 is deliberately seek-safe and visually complete so the host can pause for the physical PUSH interaction.

flash_policy.white_usage: text-face shine and thin rail accents only
flash_policy.background: remain dark through every phase, including jackpot release

customize.asset_policy: Original CSS/SVG geometry and Japanese typography only; no third-party characters, logos, photographs, or image assets.

scenes.motion: fade_in the four perimeter rails from the corners by frame 6, then hold_breath with a slow cyan current and faint ambient_glow_bloom; the center remains black and quiet
color_shift the same rails from cyan through crimson, tighten their spacing around but never inside the safe zone, and add two bounded scale_pulse accents as their travel accelerates

caption-kinetic-slam in the upper text zone using kinetic-beat-slam and 3d-text-depth-layers; settle sharp for at least 0.4s, run one white gradient-text-sweep across the face, then scale_out and fade_out while the red rails continue beneath

scenes.emotion: Resolve to suspense — gold convergence before physical PUSH
scenes.motion: color_shift the established rails from red to gold and decelerate them inward until they lock to gold_frame_extent_px; after frame 123 use only a subtle hold_breath pulse and let frame 139 resolve as a stable pause-ready state

on winning resume, reverse the same rails outward, color_shift them through a saturated rainbow spectrum, and open their ambient_glow_bloom toward the edges; use one broad scale_pulse at frame 150, then settle into a colorful non-white end hold
